national.line: A 10-year-old Jack Russell terrier named Luna was happily reunited with her owners after surviving more than a month on her own in Yellowstone National Park.
Christian McCaffrey shared a heartwarming jersey exchange with his younger brother after the two played against each other in an NFL game for the very first time.
Georgia high schoolers pulled off the birthday prank of a lifetime on their principal, 51-year-old Bobby Davis of Lakeview-Fort Oglethorpe High, a man students say changed their lives.
Knicks player Josh Hart had an NBA championship trophy braided right into his hair for the team's season opener, and the video has gone viral.
Elderly cats are being saved from being put down thanks to an adorable retirement village built just for senior cats.
An adorable cat who stayed kitten-sized his entire life surprised everyone, including his owners, by living all the way to age 14.
First responders in Florida rescued a dog that had fallen into a sinkhole and reunited the pup with its family.
A Harvard study that followed shy babies for years found shyness is inborn brain wiring, but most kids outgrow it: of 10 very shy one-year-olds, only 3 stay very shy as teens.
A California woman says in a viral video that she actually prefers sleeping on airport floors to hotel beds, and she even plans her trips around it.

pride.label: National Award
pride.line: Congrats to Lebanon Schools for earning the National Meritorious Budget Award.

pride.label: Grand Opening
pride.line: Congrats to Lebanon Schools on the opening of the new Robert W. Plaster Center for Student Success.

pride.label: New Coach
pride.line: Congrats to Brittany Stamm on being named Lebanon Schools' new head girls basketball coach.

pride.label: New Coach
pride.line: Congrats to Kalem Copling on being named Lebanon Schools' new head boys basketball coach.

pride.label: All District
pride.line: Congrats to Lebanon girls tennis players Lilly Bradbury, Ava Johnson and Carli Alford for earning All District honors, with Bradbury taking fourth in singles and Johnson and Alford taking fourth in doubles.

pride.label: World Food Champ Finalists
pride.line: Congrats to Waynesville's Molly McDermitt, Cycila Keeney and Samantha Etheridge for becoming finalists in the World Food Championships in Indianapolis on Oct. 18. Their winning dish - Bacon Lover's Christmas.

pride.label: Project Teach Award
pride.line: Congrats to Waynesville's Kyleen Oxendine, an East Elementary teacher, for winning the first-quarter Project Teach Award on Oct. 19 for her Take Home Reading Success Kits.

pride.label: Central District Band
pride.line: Congrats to these Waynesville High School students for making the Central District Band at auditions at Rolla High School on Oct. 13: Payton Rushing, Ericah Njuguna, Tyler Silbanuz, Ethan Schacke, Ethan Schnacke, Vivien Lu, Zoe Striplin, Alexzander Romans, Myra (Archer) Gutierrez, Aliyah Bowers, Kevin Connor, Aiden York, Jenna Ballard, Juliet Piper, Matthew Hinton, Mikaila Knight, Haley Brown, Landon Boswell, Harley Atchison and Zayden Fikes. They play a free concert at Rolla High School at 5 p.m. on Nov. 7.

pride.label: Spirit Trophy
pride.line: Congrats to Waynesville's Sixth Grade Center for winning the traveling Tiger Spirit Trophy again for its first-place finish in the 2026 Homecoming Parade.

pride.label: Community Award
pride.line: Congrats to Domino's of Waynesville for receiving the district's Community Recognition Plaque for October for its ongoing support, especially of students who took part in Showcase Waynesville Schools.

pride.label: Record Test Scores
pride.line: Congrats to Bolivar Schools for the strongest academic performance in district history since the Missouri Assessment Program began in 1998.

pride.label: Graduates
pride.line: Congrats to Bolivar's Lathan Martin and Boone Shockley, of Grand Missouri Bank, for graduating from the Oklahoma Bankers Association Consumer Lending School in Oklahoma City.

pride.label: Perfect Inspection
pride.line: Congrats to Parkview Health Care Facility in Bolivar for passing its annual state inspection with no deficiencies.

pride.label: Band Award
pride.line: Congrats to the Marshfield High School marching band for taking fourth at the Ozark Mountain Marching Festival.

pride.label: 100 Years in Business
pride.line: Congrats to Marshfield Chevrolet on 100 years of serving the Marshfield community.

pride.label: New Leader
pride.line: Congrats to Keith Klostermann, a 30-year educator, on being named the new city administrator for Osage Beach.

local.line: Lebanon Schools' Hive Depot is providing essential resources and learning opportunities for Lebanon students.
A Lebanon-area church built a wheelchair ramp for a disabled woman, as reported by the Laclede County Record.
Another new logo has been proposed for the City of Lebanon.
All 10 Waynesville school buses picked at random passed a surprise Missouri State Highway Patrol inspection on Oct. 20, earning a perfect 100 percent rating.
BTC Bank presented the City of Buffalo with a $50,000 check to finish funding Phase 1 of the Buffalo Community Center repair project.
New details are out on a 126-room Hyatt hotel planned in Backwater Jacks' Cove at Lake of the Ozarks.
A Lake of the Ozarks nonprofit is helping women start over by offering hope, housing and support.
Two new troopers have joined the Missouri State Highway Patrol in the Lake of the Ozarks area.
The Polk County Museum staff recently hosted a group of homeschoolers who came to learn about Cherokee history and customs.
The Buffalo High School Class of 1972 held its 54th class reunion with a potluck dinner at the Riddick Masonic Lodge in Buffalo on Sept. 26.

music.line: Luke Combs has extended his record with his 23rd straight number one song on country radio, 'Be By You.'
Bo Bryan, son of country star Luke Bryan and a 2027 quarterback recruit, has picked up a scholarship offer from the University of Georgia.
Riley Green says he wants to be a dad, and he pictures fatherhood with camo, hunting trips and plenty of new songs down the line.
A new mural has been painted to honor country star Lainey Wilson.
Cole Swindell has turned family memories into his new single, 'Bronco.'
Brooks and Dunn celebrated 35 years of their 'Brand New Man' album with a surprise show in Nashville.
Emily Ann Roberts is heading out on her first-ever headlining run, 'The Thread Tour,' hitting 23 cities in the spring of 2027.
The two-hour Dolly Parton tribute special, 'CMA Presents I Will Always Love You,' is coming to TV with a lineup of country stars paying tribute.
Little Big Town, HARDY and the Red Clay Strays will lead 'New Year's Eve Live: Nashville's Big Bash' on December 31 on CBS and Paramount Plus.
Blake Shelton, Rascal Flatts and Brad Paisley will headline VOA Fest 2026.
Emmy-winning duo The War and Treaty will receive the first-ever Origins Vanguard Award at the 2026 Origins Impact Awards.

weird.line: An angler at Lake of the Ozarks snagged a 164-pound paddlefish, setting a new world record right here in our backyard.
A Texas racetrack celebrated its upcoming Formula One race by unveiling a cowboy hat sculpture that Guinness confirmed is the largest cowboy hat in the world.
A Rhode Island man grew the first pumpkin ever to top 3,000 pounds, making his gargantuan gourd the largest fruit ever recorded.
An Asian elephant named Samudra stomped a 500-pound pumpkin flat during the Oregon Zoo's 28th annual Squishing of the Squash.
An Idaho sheriff's deputy rescued a moose found in Latah County with its head and body tangled up in a whole roll of wire fencing.
Parks workers in Ohio shared photos and video of a very unexpected rider on a mountain bike trail: an escaped emu just wandering along.
A loose emu in California led police officers on a chase, proving once again that emus do not care about your schedule.
A kangaroo was on the loose in Kansas, which is not a sentence anybody expected to hear this week.
A bear was caught on camera breaking into a library in California, apparently looking for something good to read.
Firefighters in Texas rushed to help when one of several escaped horses running along a busy highway got stuck in a drainage ditch.
The San Diego Zoo picked the perfect day to announce a birth: a baby two-toed sloth arrived right on International Sloth Day.
A rare blue-tinted alligator was rescued and is now at Gatorland in Florida.
A cow named Veronica got stuck in the mud and had to be rescued.
Minnesota's so-called Pumpkin King has returned to win a national giant pumpkin title for the fifth time.
The biggest pumpkin ever grown for the Anamosa Pumpkinfest just broke the festival's site record.
Bidders flocked to Union County for one of the largest pumpkin auctions in the whole nation.
An angler at Lake Cascade set a new catch-and-release state record for bullhead catfish.
Scientists in Wyoming found the fattest squid-like creature in history, a 160-million-year-old fossil that sat forgotten in a drawer for decades.
A stone fell onto an Iowa prairie in 1890, and a farmer dug up the 66-pound meteorite and sold it for just $105.
Back in 1979, a Florida woman spent a whole week living in a 50-foot eagle's nest, and her stunt helped fund a raptor center.
The cartoonist behind The Oatmeal built Grimothy, a giant evil version of a viral short, round raccoon, in his brother's front yard on Bainbridge Island.
A tiny dog played the drums in a costume called 'Angine de Pawtrine' at the 36th annual Tompkins Square Halloween Dog Parade.
A musician in a tuxedo, Lord Vinheteiro, performed Van Halen's 'Jump' on a whole lineup of rubber chickens.
A YouTuber ran 300 million computer simulations of Monopoly to find the very best strategy for winning the game.
Bill McClintock made a giant Halloween mashup called 'Ghostmashers' that layers the Ghostbusters theme with 11 other 1980s hits.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's Back to the Future Day, which is a great reminder that we were promised hoverboards and got self-checkout lanes that yell at us instead.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's International Day of the Nacho, the only holiday where the whole point is to see how much cheese one chip can legally hold.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: Today is Count Your Buttons Day, which sounds relaxing until you realize your remote has 47 of them and you only use three.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's Babbling Day, so basically every morning show in America is just celebrating a regular Wednesday.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: Today is Hagfish Day, honoring a fish whose name sounds like what my wife calls me before I've had my coffee.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Pumpkin Cheesecake Day, proof that pumpkin spice season has officially stopped asking permission.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: Today is Garbanzo Bean Day, a big day for the bean that's also a chickpea, the only food with a secret identity.

humor.label: Viral
humor.line: The internet is debating 'outside clothes' versus 'inside clothes,' and every dad in America just learned he's been wearing outside clothes to bed for 20 years.

humor.label: Viral
humor.line: A woman on TikTok says she'd be suspicious if her boyfriend were good at taking photos, so fellas, those blurry pictures you take are actually proof of loyalty.

humor.label: Viral
humor.line: The new 'A Haunted House But...' trend swaps monsters for real-life scares, and honestly, a haunted house where you open your credit card bill would clear the building.

humor.label: One-Liner
humor.line: I just finished reading a book called 'How to Clear Leaves From Your Lawn,' by Ray King.

humor.label: One-Liner
humor.line: My daughter said she was starting to like my beard, but I knew she was lying when she said it was growing on her.

humor.label: One-Liner
humor.line: My daughter wanted to go out without her glasses, and I told her no daughter of mine is going out looking like that.

humor.label: One-Liner
humor.line: To cut a long story short, I became an editor.

humor.label: One-Liner
humor.line: I treat every day like I'm running a marathon tomorrow: I rest, load up on carbs, and find a way to mention I'm not running in every conversation.

humor.label: One-Liner
humor.line: My wife and I still have chemistry, but at our age most of it involves antacids and prescription bottles.

humor.label: One-Liner
humor.line: Why did Winnie the Pooh burn himself taking a pizza out of the oven? He used his bear hands.

humor.label: One-Liner
humor.line: I treat my girlfriend like a princess: I gave her thousands of responsibilities and put the weight of a whole country on her shoulders.

humor.label: One-Liner
humor.line: Why do pandas get confused after they eat? Because they just got bamboozled.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's Eat a Pretzel Day, honoring what may be the world's oldest snack, so people have been getting salt stuck in their teeth for centuries.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Nut Day, celebrated in the U.S. since at least 2000, though every family reunion has been observing it a lot longer than that.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Tavern-Style Pizza Day, for the thin Midwestern pie cut into squares, because somebody decided triangles were too much commitment.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Sparkling Water Day, started by a home soda-machine company, for people who like their water to feel a little bit spicy.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Knee Day, honoring the largest joint in your body, which after 35 is mostly used to announce that you're standing up.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Color Day, all about how colors change your mood, which explains why everybody's mood changes when the check-engine light comes on.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's Smart is Cool Day, so if anybody calls you a nerd today, correct their grammar and walk away.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Croc Day, started by a fan, and when Crocs sold a gold version for the day in 2018 it sold out in hours, so no shoe is too ugly to sell out.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Boston Cream Pie Day, for the dessert invented in 1856 at Boston's Parker House Hotel, which is actually a cake, so Boston has been fibbing for 170 years.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's Mole Day, which chemistry teachers celebrate from 6:02 a.m. to 6:02 p.m. in honor of Avogadro's number, making it the nerdiest happy hour in America.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Canning Day, honoring the Frenchman who invented canning to win Napoleon's 12,000-franc prize, and every grandma in the Ozarks has been doing it for free ever since.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's TV Talk Show Host Day, on Johnny Carson's birthday, who hosted The Tonight Show for 30 years, which is about how long it takes us to find the remote.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Horror Movie Day, the one night a year couples agree on a movie, and one of them watches it through their fingers.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National iPod Day, so dig yours out of the junk drawer, because it still has that 2007 playlist you're scared to play in front of people.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's 40-Hour Work Week Day, marking the 1938 law that set the 40-hour week and a 25-cent minimum wage, and every small business owner is still waiting for their 40-hour week to kick in.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Bologna Day, and the lunch meat is named after Bologna, Italy, which is the fanciest thing that has ever happened to a fried bologna sandwich.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Good and Plenty Day, honoring the oldest candy brand in America, made since 1893, and still the candy left in the bowl after Halloween.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Crazy Day, a day to break your routine and act a little unhinged, which for parents of toddlers is just called Saturday.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's World Tripe Day, celebrating cow stomach lining, the one food that makes liver and onions look like the popular kid.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's Mother-in-Law Day, so call her and compliment her cooking, and remember your tone of voice will be discussed at Thanksgiving.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Greasy Foods Day, the one day a year your cardiologist officially looks the other way.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's Sourest Day, created by a Michigan man to honor his old roommate on his birthday, and the roommate's last name was, no kidding, Sauer.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's World Pasta Day, and pasta comes in ribbons, cords and tubes, which is also how most of us describe the Christmas lights in the attic.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's Punk for a Day Day, so dress like the Ramones, which for most dads means one rip in a jean jacket and a midlife crisis.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Tight Ends Day, held every fourth Sunday in October, and yes, every guy in the office is going to make the same joke.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Mule Day, celebrating the cross between a male donkey and a female horse, and here in Missouri, where the mule is the state animal, that's practically a state holiday.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Pumpkin Day, and the word pumpkin comes from the Greek word for 'large melon,' which is what we'll all look like after Thanksgiving.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's Texas Chicken Fried Steak Day, started by a Dallas PR man, and the Ozarks would like to point out we never needed a press release to eat one.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's Horseless Carriage Day, from back when a car was named for what it didn't have, like a cordless phone, or a weekend without a kids' tournament.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Mincemeat Day, for a pie filling that usually doesn't even have meat in it anymore, the most misleading name since Boston cream pie.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's Cranky Co-Workers Day, the one day you let the office complainer complain all they want, which, let's be honest, is every day.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Potato Day, and the potato is in the nightshade family, same as the tomato, so French fries are basically a salad.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's Boxer Shorts Day, a holiday most husbands have been quietly celebrating every Saturday since the wedding.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's National Parmigiano Reggiano Day, for the cheese that ages up to 40 months and still looks better than any of us after 40 months of raising toddlers.

humor.label: Today Is
humor.line: It's World Pizza Makers Day, honoring the people who toss dough by hand, and not those of us whose pizza-making skill is preheating the oven.
